author: skratch
body:
I’m like level 238 and play exclusively realmshifter classes, but don’t consider myself an expert at all. There’s a [spreadsheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/115Ve76FNq6fys8X8kb2dR6K3yyEXv04YJo0yAoob_uY/edit?usp=drivesdk) you should definitely check out that has a bunch of equipment and build info. If you haven’t unlocked RS Corvus or RS Dorado from the towers, I would work towards that. You also want to unlock other t10 classes so you can use their spells, for example Golems Fortitude and Mimics Mischief are must-haves.

Once you turn T10 you want to do the quest to get an Old Nothren Crown. Masterforge even the white quality one as it has great stats - I filled mine with crit adornments. You also want to get a good quality fey yeti coat (must be the fey version). I would also secure a good 2H weapon. The main one I use for raids is an Arisen Nagamaki because of the bleed immunity but more so because the Slice attack doesn’t cost mana, hits about twice as hard as a regular attack, does physical damage, and can hit additional opponents. For hordes you want to get an arisen gandring from the arisen mammon, because it has a free attack that hits all opponents. Use the wyvern speed ii and wyrm’s song buffs to up your attack and crit. 

Don’t use elemental spells or whatever, enchant your weapon with dragon damage and have earth affinity in case you run into something immune to dragon damage

My main setup is RS Oracle with 2X amities that give 40% more damage from crits. Usually use this for monumentsz

For towers I use an RS Dorado/Blade of Finesse with a single +40% crit damage amity.

For both of the above I was lucky to get a cursed kings blade, but before that used an arisen gandring

For raids I use RS Corvus/raider with a +40% crit damage amity, except for tower titans I swap that with a -80% dragon damage amity (to resist their towerfall nukes).

Typically for a raid I will cast: ward of ortanite, golems fortitude, divine bastion ii, barrier 2, berserk iii, curse of sekhmet, mimics mischief, wyvern speed ii until I get atk+, gait of gunnr, bloodshift, deific channel, wyrm’s song for the crit+, then I spam Slice until they die (usually 15-30 hits later)

author: ewolf0113
body:
For a fresh t10 I would recommend you grind out a maxed celestial bow with tower shard and fill it with hands of Prometheus. Pair it with a high ward shield (arisen from arisen mammon/ymir coiled from Wyrm event/phoenician from phoenix/etc)

For helmet, Eastern Mask from  
Thronemaker is probably new BiS for us, but fallen sky is good, base old northren is still quite good… anything with ward/crit really.

For body, same idea: snag the highest ward chest you can find and slap crit and/or 2% ward adorns in it.

For boots, October will put dullahan boots on the table. I really like them for the t.att buff. In the meantime, just grab crit and ward again.

I think berserker is ideal for base RS for comfort. There’s a new option with the new pet last event, but I wouldn’t recommend it for your game state.

Try to get your hands on a 40% crit damage amity for a huge bump in damage. Keep your stonewarg until you start feeling comfortable with the class. Phoenix is a huge damage bump but the ward turns are inconsistent, and a fresh t10 RS is probably already overtaxed trying not to die to DoTs, so having to manage ward turns can be frustrating. 

Speaking of being overtaxed, you could try to get yourself a piece of dynasty gear for access to curse of sekhmet. It’s a toggle skill that prevents healing instead of Bloodshift, but you lose the other benefits from Bloodshift. To accomplish that, see if anyone in guild has some spare sphinx scrolls from last event.

Overall, try to get your crit up to 75% so you can hit crit cap using wyrm song. If you picked up the blue dog follower option it’s your stonewarg, I would highly suggest learning a little of beo to make clearing towers/killing Prometheus easier. I did it as an RS and recall it being a nightmare early on, but the celestial bow will be your best friend for a long time.

If you want more information/have other question, you can add me on discord: zeke3485
